_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-70 coil base rate demands a visible breaker before calling direction, and neither brain has produced one—analyst sees none, narrative infers one from an analog the analyst has credibly challenged.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with downside skew if ETF flows don't recover; narrative implies accumulation leading to upside. The split is fundamental: same pattern, opposite read on whether divergences invalidate it.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows break above 20 with stablecoin growth rising above 55 and funding cooling below 40 — this would validate the accumulation narrative and shift toward Hope (8).
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay below 10 with funding climbing above 60 and BTC dominance fade accelerating above 60 — this would confirm broken Disbelief rolling toward Anxiety (5) or prolonged Complacency chop.
